Remark
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0054 1. Remark 2.19\group neckpinch

For the warped-product metric $ds^2+\psi ^2g_{\mathrm{can}}$, the sectional curvatures are $K_0=-\psi _{ss}/\psi $ and $K_1=(1-\psi _s^2)/\psi ^2$, and the Ricci tensor is $\Rc =(nK_0)ds^2+(K_0+(n-1)K_1)g_{\mathrm{can}}$.
